grid: 1 km × 1 km cells, 30 × 30 km pilot windows
blockers: fire_observation_valid cannot yet flag cloud/smoke-obscured days: no per-cell VIIRS cloud mask is ingested, so 'valid' negatives are unverified (insufficient_observation = 0 is a limitation, not a finding)
Land cover is the latest annual Esri/IO map applied to all years (static) — not year-matched
Same-day NASA POWER weather is included although it publishes ~2–4 days later; operational models need a latency lag
admin2 not assigned (no admin boundary dataset connected)
Pilot windows only (30×30 km each); not region- or country-wide
Weather/soil are 0.5°×0.625° POWER cells: all 1 km cells in a POWER cell share the source value (labelled, not resampled)

rules: Feature engineering statistics (e.g. NDVI baselines, scalers) are fit on train only
Test period stays untouched until final evaluation
